summary: Add mobile sign-in and verified user sessions to an API, with protected routes and account-free local tests.
description: Connect Expo sign-in to session verification in the Hono API. Protected routes require a verified user id, with a small public-path allowlist and explicit local bypass. Tests use a local signing key to exercise real verification without a Clerk account. Configure the Clerk application, keys and redirect URLs before live sign-in; application-specific permissions and record ownership still need implementation.
seoDescription: Clerk sign-in for Expo and verified Hono API sessions, with protected routes, an explicit local bypass and account-free verification tests.

projectExamples.title: Private reading log
projectExamples.description: Use verified user ids to scope custom book records to their owner. Clerk supplies sessions; you implement ownership checks and the reading screens.

projectExamples.title: Member settings screen
projectExamples.description: Build a mobile settings page around the authenticated API identity route. Add profile fields and update rules as application code.
